residuals.finding: A relayed claim that in five of eight the surviving value is a reversible default displacing an owner-accepted one is wrong on the count: it is six, not five. RULED_ survives over a discarded OWNER_ACCEPTED_ in six keys; the remaining two are OWNER_ACCEPTED against OWNER_ACCEPTED. Two qualifications matter more than the count: the displacement is a property of main rather than of this change, because YAML last-wins had already made RULED_ the only value any program read and this diff changes zero parsed values; and the RULED_ reading is grounded in the record, since decisions/0046 states none of its rulings is an owner acceptance, and both acceptance/accepted/ and STATUS.yaml owner_accepted list A1 through A5.
residuals.corrected: This entry originally read 'A1 through A4'. Corrected after the session that reported the original count re-derived it and flagged the range as stale. Verified independently: acceptance/accepted/ holds A1.json through A5.json, and STATUS.yaml owner_accepted lists A5 first, accepted by seat:root at 2026-08-26T16:34:35Z for the orientation snapshot gate. residuals.finding: The head is six commits behind main and lacks main's worktrees entry in lint's SKIP_PARTS. Run at the head alone in a tree carrying agent worktrees, which is this repository's real local layout, lint fails with duplicate-key defects belonging to other branches. The witness merged current origin/main into the head in a scratch worktree: clean auto-merge, and on that merged state lint passes, the reintroduced-duplicate mutation is still caught, and verify passes at SILVER 13.855s. The state attested as landable is the merge, not the head in isolation.

check_duplicate_keys is a line reader and never parses YAML, so a file that does not parse at all still passes it. Demonstrated accidentally with a malformed edit lint reported clean. The docstring declares the reader is line-based and STATUS.yaml is parsed elsewhere in the gate, so nothing is currently mis-graded, but the PASS line's YAML document count reads stronger than what was measured.
Two harness files quote a console_service_status value STATUS.yaml no longer carries. Pre-existing and outside the eight, but the same class of drift this change repaired in three sibling skills.
A diagram quotes a classification_status value STATUS.yaml no longer carries. Pre-existing, disclosed by the builder, and invisible to sov_diagrams.py because that view declares only two sources.

accepted_repository_claims in STATUS.yaml still lists all six demoted subjects. Disclosed by the builder and left for Bdo, but named in a pull request body rather than presented at a seam; sov_accept.py audit reports zero open questions, so nothing in the gate holds it.

The two OWNER_ACCEPTED-against-OWNER_ACCEPTED pairs are not both clean supersets, and the original form of DUP-R1 implied they were. sdlc_loop_status is clean: the survivor gains the packet id A3 and keeps everything else. engineering_framework_status is not: the discarded value reads OWNER_ACCEPTED_PHASE_I_REFERENCE_BASELINE_BUDGET_GRADED_UNDER_0042 and the survivor reads OWNER_ACCEPTED_A1_PHASE_I_REFERENCE_BASELINE, so it gains A1 and drops the budget-grading pointer. Deleting that duplicate loses the pointer unless the survivor absorbs it.
residuals.but: Checking what the pointer addresses shows it should not be absorbed, because it is already wrong. decisions/0042 is 'The decision queue is not a queue' both locally and on origin/main. The budget grading is decisions/0050, which records in its own numbering note that it was drafted as 0042 and renumbered because 0042 was taken before it could land. So the discarded value points at a pre-renumber draft number that no longer holds the budget grading anywhere. Deleting it removes a stale pointer rather than a live one, which strengthens the change rather than weakening it.
residuals.consequence: The same stale pointer survives this change in the harness, where the pull request's sweep does not reach. .claude/skills/sov-verification/SKILL.md:30 tells a reader 'only passing 15.0s fails. decisions/0042', and line 52 quotes the full OWNER_ACCEPTED_PHASE_I_REFERENCE_BASELINE_BUDGET_GRADED_UNDER_0042 spelling. Every agent that loads the verification-domain skill is pointed at the decision-queue record for a rule that lives in 0050 - and 0050 is the record Bdo has not yet ruled on.
residuals.what_would_have_defeated_this_finding: a decisions/0042 that held the budget grading, or a sov-verification skill citing 0050

judgement_items: Does the record stand as RULED_ for the six subjects whose deleted duplicate said OWNER_ACCEPTED? The parsed value on main was already RULED_ and this change alters nothing a program reads, but the file now shows RULED_ with no visible counterclaim while accepted_repository_claims still lists the same six as accepted. That tension is now the only reading left in the file.
Should the six subjects be presented for acceptance as packets, ruled explicitly again, or removed from accepted_repository_claims? This reaches Bdo under product intent.
